title: デイリー杯ジュニアSの後に・次なる牙

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I run a good race, but what was with Bright's blindingly fast final spurt?! Is that… the real power of an Umamusume family?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The race is barely over before Mejiro Dober comes up to me and declares that she's going to surpass me! Defeat one challenger, and another appears…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Umamusume families are a greater force to be reckoned with than I thought! I have to find out more about the truth of their strength before the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies!
